summary: This 8-K is filed by Atara Biotherapeutics to disclose a regulatory update from a Type A meeting with the FDA regarding the Complete Response Letter for the tabelecleucel BLA. The filing reports that the FDA agreed a single-arm study with an appropriate historical control could support resubmission. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation event is announced. The filing is a routine regulatory update and does not qualify as a special situation. The registrant reports only on ongoing regulatory interactions with no deal terms or structural changes.
